items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Lennie called me and asked me to come over and help him record.

ctx.x: Probably some minimum charge, not enough to sustain anything; you know?
Okay, so then you would visit—another interesting thing to me was another of your earlier recordings. I think it was what you first said you got credit for was involved with Lennie Tristano.

Yeah one of the musicians, or Lennie, I don’t know how we got together. It must have been one of the musicians who knew Lennie, and then Lennie called me and asked me to come over and help him record.
